text: Another message on Thursday, Iran also claimed that it struck seven oil tankers in the Strait of Hormuz, which, if true, would be the largest single-day hit in the strait since the start of the war in late February. US President Donald Trump, however, called those claims fake, saying the regime is intentionally driving up the price of oil ahead of the US midterm elections. Now, there are a number of indicators that the fighting might pick back up after Americans vote on November 3rd from the New York Times, US and Israel draw up plans for renewed strikes on Iran after elections. It doesn't get more explicit than that.
